sampling.sampling:
Uniform seeded valid-cell sample, round-robin 20° strata; no target balancing.

    Retains zero suitability. One candidate per conservative 1.5° footprint
    reduces redundant climate requests; counts are not independence claims.
    
Preregistered supplement: independent candidate seed 43, pool 1200; test/train/validation quotas 60/40/20 using split seed 42; 150 km and coarse-footprint spacing from all original/chosen cells; no selection on label magnitude, soil availability or model error.

limitations: Approximates a modeled GAEZ assessment, not observed farm success.
POWER and GAEZ AgERA5 are different climate products despite aligned years.
Coarse regional climate and ~10 km labels do not establish field precision.
0–5 cm modeled soil is not a laboratory test or a full root-zone profile.
Coverage screening is conservative and is not a complete Phase 5 reliability system.
No confidence percentage, yield, management benefit or rotation advice is provided.
